'''P-2XN''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. P-2XN was stationed as a courier aboard the Republic's [[Carrick Station]], delivering messages and mission briefings to the Republic personnel aboard. In [[3640 BBY]], he was dispatched to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] in order to recruit Republic operatives to deal with the threat of the [[Directive 7]].<ref name="TOR:VU" />

==Behind the scenes==
P-2XN was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. P-2XN serves as a courier to introduce the Flashpoint Directive 7.<ref name="TOR:VU" />
